SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(solarmodulepower) AS "Solarleistung",
  avg(loadpower) AS "Lastleistung",
  avg(energyexchangepower) AS "Energieaustauschleistung",
  avg(batterypower) AS "Batterieleistung"  
FROM "etminiature-house" 
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index) AND 
  name in ($HausId)
GROUP BY time, name

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(solarmodulevoltage) AS "Solarmodulspannung",
  avg(loadvoltage) AS "Lastspannung",
  avg(energyexchangevoltage) AS "Energieaustauschspannung",
  avg(batteryvoltage) AS "Batteriespannung"  
FROM "etminiature-house" 
WHERE
